title: The Toro Company to Present at D.A. Davidson 25th Annual Diversified Industrials & Services Conference
summary: The Investor Relations website contains information about The Toro Company's business for stockholders, potential investors, and financial analysts.
body_markdown:
BLOOMINGTON, Minn.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Sep. 17, 2026-- The Toro Company (NYSE: TTC), a leading global provider of solutions for the outdoor environment, today announced that President and Chief Operating Officer Edric Funk will participate in a fireside chat at the D.A. Davidson 25th Annual Diversified Industrials & Services Conference at 10:30 a.m. ET on Friday, September 25, 2026.


A live webcast of the fireside chat and a replay of the event will be available at[www.thetorocompany.com/news-events/events](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.thetorocompany.com%2Fnews-events%2Fevents&esheet=54604498&newsitemid=20260917674804&lan=en-US&anchor=www.thetorocompany.com%2Fnews-events%2Fevents&index=1&md5=e1ecb5573c364300e18c7cd223a73ba8) .


**About The Toro Company**


The Toro Company (NYSE: TTC) is a leading global provider of solutions for the outdoor environment including turf and landscape maintenance, snow and ice management, underground construction, rental and specialty construction, and irrigation and outdoor lighting solutions. With net sales of $4.5 billion in fiscal 2025, The Toro Company’s global presence extends to more than 125 countries through a family of brands that includes Toro, Ditch Witch, Exmark, BOSS, Ventrac, Tornado, HammerHead, American Augers, Spartan, Subsite, Radius, Hayter, Perrot, Unique Lighting Systems, Irritrol, and Lawn-Boy. Through constant innovation and caring relationships built on trust and integrity, The Toro Company and its family of brands have built a legacy of excellence by helping customers work on golf courses, sports fields, construction sites, public green spaces, commercial and residential properties and agricultural operations. For more information, visit[www.thetorocompany.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.thetorocompany.com&esheet=54604498&newsitemid=20260917674804&lan=en-US&anchor=www.thetorocompany.com&index=2&md5=6048a4a88621978a0be2e288099637d5) .
